mapper.sql: select w.wallet_id, w.member_id, w.type_code, t.type_name, w.currency, w.available, w.frozen, w.create_time, w.update_time from biz_wallet w left join biz_wallet_type t on t.type_code = w.type_code
mapper.select: where w.member_id = #{memberId} and w.type_code = #{typeCode} and w.currency = #{currency}

select wallet_id, member_id, type_code, null as type_name, currency, available, frozen, create_time, update_time from biz_wallet where member_id = #{memberId} and type_code = #{typeCode} and currency = #{currency} for update
where w.member_id = #{memberId} order by ifnull(t.sort, 99) asc, w.currency asc
select count(1) from biz_wallet where type_code = #{typeCode}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_wallet (member_id, type_code, currency, available, frozen, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{typeCode}, #{currency}, #{available}, #{frozen}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_wallet set available = #{available}, frozen = #{frozen}, update_time = sysdate() where wallet_id = #{walletId}
